In this document i will calculate and compare the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain between humans, pigs and mice
```{r}
total_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_human)
total_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_pig)
total_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_mouse)
```
the species with the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression was humans with 430
